additional_concerns: The nav > 0 scope condition is not stated in the circular. It excludes zero or negative NAV even where an applicable SFC designation exists; unknown NAV also prevents that route from resolving classification. Separate measurement validity from legal scope.
The doubled exposure sum correctly implements the inclusive 50% threshold in exact common units: 2 × (direct_exposure + indirect_exposure) >= nav.

No exposure methodology is supplied despite the representation referring to one. Valuation, look-through, netting and double counting remain unresolved; the formula does not establish the correctness of supplied exposure amounts.
Assessment timing, reassessment frequency and designation expiry are not established by the supplied circular.
Global conflict blocking can prevent classification even when an independent route is established. This is an implementation convention, not a circular requirement.
The three unbound dependency IDs have no mappings to named authorities. They cannot safely be assigned to particular missing documents.

Footnote 1 identifies a separate direct-investment limit under UT Code 7.3. This classification result does not establish compliance with that limit; assessing it requires the missing applicable UT Code provision.
The separate LAF circular is missing. It is unnecessary to apply this exclusion, but necessary to assess the treatment of excluded LAFs.
